items.title: ‘Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom’ Director on Why AI Is Not a Threat: ‘There’s a Desire to See the Craft Behind the Finished Product’
items.excerpt: Aardman co-director Matthew Walker explains why he sees generative AI as no threat to stop-motion animation, arguing audiences want to see the craft behind the finished product.

items.title: AI Can Critique Shakespeare but Can’t Write It, Russo Brothers’ AGBO Execs Tell Tokyo Market
items.excerpt: At a TIFFCOM keynote, AGBO's technology heads argued AI should support artists and can't match the human element of storytelling.

items.title: Mayur More & Ashlesha Thakur To Lead AI Hybrid Movie 'Beta Builder'
items.excerpt: Abundantia Entertainment's AI unit AiOn and video-tech firm InVideo are making 'Beta Builder', a hybrid feature that pairs live actors with AI-generated production.

items.title: View Conference Was Inspiring: The AI Sales Pitches Were Exhausting (And Occasionally Bullshit)
items.excerpt: Filmmakers shared their craft at Turin's View Conference, while AI evangelists (a real job title of one speaker) insisted everyone already uses the technology.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio update: MotionVFX and AI
items.excerpt: Apple Creator Studio's free November update builds MotionVFX into Final Cut Pro and adds AI assistants across its creative apps.

items.title: 2026 AI Horror Film Competition Winners!
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge wraps its 4th annual AI Horror Film Competition, announcing the winning AI-made horror films.

items.title: Kling AI 4.0 suggests a shift in AI video competition from visual quality to directorial control
items.excerpt: Kuaishou's Kling AI 4.0 shifts AI video generation from impressive single clips toward director-style control over shots, camera and continuity for short films and ads.

items.title: From AI generation to final cut, Fotor Agent takes on the video production workflow
items.excerpt: Fotor Agent aims to carry AI video from generation through editing to a finished cut, targeting the gap between impressive clips and usable productions.

items.title: ByteDance Is Rewiring Its AI Video Bet
items.excerpt: ByteDance's CapCut unit folded its Xiaoyunque AI video product into Jimeng, consolidating its AI video creation tools around one platform.

items.title: [REVIEW] 'Steelay' opens new era for AI feature films
items.excerpt: Korea's first fully generative-AI sci-fi action feature 'Steelay' hit local theaters on Oct. 21, which the Korea Times review frames as the start of a new era for AI feature films.

items.title: 한예종 AI 애니 '티켓 투 네버랜드'…일본 영화제 최종 경쟁 진출
items.excerpt: 한국예술종합학교 AT랩이 제작한 3D AI 애니메이션 '티켓 투 네버랜드'가 60여개국 730여편이 출품된 일본 국제 AI 영화제 경쟁 부문 파이널리스트 21편에 올랐다.

items.title: 헬로웍스, 1959년 한국 SF 영웅 ‘라이파이’를 AI 애니메이션으로 되살린다
items.excerpt: 원작자 김산호 화백이 크리에이티브 디렉션에 참여해 캐릭터 레퍼런스→AI 생성 컷→사람의 연출 순서로 제작하며, 미국 공개는 다큐멘터리로 시작한다.

items.title: Google’s next Genie AI model generates more realistic experiences
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 world model generates more realistic, explorable AI environments, letting users explore realistic AI-generated worlds.

items.title: Idris Elba's Akuna Group Launches Free AI Filmmaking Program For African Creators
items.excerpt: Idris Elba's Akuna Group, with Google, launches a free AI filmmaking programme for creators in five African countries.

items.title: HKU Business School Releases Report on Gen AI Video Generation Capabilities
items.excerpt: HKU Business School released a report evaluating the capabilities of generative AI video models.

items.title: Execs at 'Avengers' studio AGBO talk AI limitations and looking to Japan
items.excerpt: AGBO's Chris Brearton and Dominic Hughes led a TIFFCOM keynote on AI's limitations and the studio's interest in Japan.
